description: Own what you build, from first commit to long after go-live. Anyone can ship a feature. Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, SaaS, Logistics, and EdTech. A voice that counts: You’ll influence our technical direction, and your role goes well beyond closing tickets.
